sloka: यानि माल्यानि देवेषु यानि चैत्ररथे वने ।प्रयागे तान्यदृश्यन्त भरद्वाजस्य तेजसा ॥ २.९१.४७॥
transliteration: yāni mālyāni deveṣu yāni caitrarathe vane ।prayāge tānyadṛśyanta bharadvājasya tejasā ॥ 2.91.47॥

translations.english: Thereafter, the apsaras, Alambusa, Misrakesi, Pundarika and Vamana danced near Bharata at the command of Bharadwaja.
